audit.report: A settlement_worker running gift_card_ledger_post (pid 1274023) went idle in transaction for 4.2s holding locks, blocking 12 sessions and degrading checkout to 14% success (113/132 failed) with $15,752/min revenue at risk. The Database Guardian proposed waiting but first gathered missing evidence: the workload is PROTECTED_SETTLEMENT with replayable=False and interrupt_policy=never_interrupt, no protected settlements were in flight, and no change calendar window applied. Tradeoff analysis showed expected remaining runtime ~46s, fitting within the 60s business tolerance at a cost of ~$12,024. The Continuity Guardian accepted, forming a pact to wait in 1 round. The blocker finished on its own after 0s of waiting, and verification confirmed full recovery: 100% checkout success (36/36), no lock waits, and no protected operations aborted.
audit.root_cause: The gift_card_ledger_post settlement worker entered an idle-in-transaction state (last statement SELECT 1) while holding locks, blocking all checkout sessions.
lessons: gift_card_ledger_post is classified PROTECTED_SETTLEMENT with never_interrupt — add this metadata to the workload registry so guardians can decide instantly without probe round trips.
audit.negotiation_critique: Database Guardian proposed wait but correctly demanded missing evidence (workload registry, protected settlements, change calendar, tradeoff) in the same round; Continuity Guardian accepted immediately on the returned evidence. No round was wasted, no evidence was missed, and the never_interrupt invariant was respected — agreement reached in 1 round.
follow_ups: Investigate why gift_card_ledger_post enters idle-in-transaction with SELECT 1 (likely application bug in finance-ledger service).
Add gift_card_ledger_post to workload registry with replayable=False, interrupt_policy=never_interrupt, class=PROTECTED_SETTLEMENT for instant lookup.
Add alert for settlement workers idle-in-transaction > 5s to detect stalls before they block checkout.
